title: Kit for the rim
text:
Tarred line, every fathom marked. Three lengths, spliced.
Lead, 14 lb, cupped and armed with tallow.
Chronometer, Polytechnic stores. Not returned.
The ladder down the Lowvents rim, by arrangement with nobody.
Read at first light, when the steam thins.
Read twice. Write down the second.
If the two disagree, read a third time and buy better line.
